title: How are higher interest rates and rising prices affecting you? | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

Last month, the Federal Reserveraised interest ratesfor the first time in more than three years, as it tries to bring inflation under control. But higher rates make borrowing more expensive for consumers and businesses — one reasonmortgage rates have climbedto a three-year high in recent weeks.

It could take time before consumers see much relief from rising prices. And more rate hikes could be on the way, too.

If you’re feeling the squeeze both from higher prices and higher borrowing costs, we want to hear from you.
